note: Devin uses a configurable model backend. The Devin workspace admin sets the default model. Devin supports per-session model selection via environment variables or workspace settings.

tier-s.rationale: Devin's long-running sessions benefit from Sonnet's large context window and code reasoning. Use for architecture design and multi-wave implementation.

tier-a.rationale: Spec validation and QA analysis require the same model strength. Devin's ability to run tests and iterate makes Sonnet ideal.

tier-b.rationale: Discovery and task planning are shorter sessions. Haiku reduces cost without sacrificing quality for these analytical tasks.

tier-c.rationale: Knowledge agent runs on a schedule (summarization, state manifest updates). Haiku is optimal for these repetitive, low-complexity tasks.

workspace_config.cost_saving_mode: Set default to claude-3-haiku-20240307 and manually upgrade sessions for tier-s/a agents via Devin's model override.
workspace_config.per_session_override: Devin allows model selection at session start. The squad should document which model to use for each agent type in their runbook.
